Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, pathlib
hdr=b'##fileformat=VCFv4.2\n##contig=<ID=1>\n##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description="Genotype">\n#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\tFORMAT\tS\n\0'
shared=bytes([0x07,0x17,ord('A'),0x00])
indiv=bytes([0x13,0x00,0x00])
rec=struct.pack('<IIiIifHHI',24+len(shared),len(indiv),0,0,1,0.0,0,1,(1<<24)|1)+shared+indiv
p=b'BCF\x02\x02'+struct.pack('<I',len(hdr))+hdr+rec
pathlib.Path('cand_key_oob.bcf').write_bytes(p)
print(len(p), len(hdr), len(shared), len(indiv))
PY
